Job Description
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company's three core products are Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio , an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and it's AR glasses, Spectacles .
Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We're deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.
We're looking for a Principal Machine Learning, ML Training Platform to join Snap Inc!
What you'll do:
• Design, implement, and scale critical machine learning components and services to support Snap's most strategic initiatives
• Build a next-generation training framework that can support large-scale model training, enabling us to push the limits of what's possible with machine learning
• Perform training and model performance optimization with various GPUs to improve model training speed and efficiency
• Develop an AutoML platform to accelerate model generation and automate the machine learning model lifecycle
• Work across teams to understand product requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and deliver the solutions needed to build innovative products or services
• Advocate for and apply best practices when it comes to availability, scalability, operational excellence, and cost management
• Provide technical direction that influences the entire company

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
• Strong understanding of machine learning approaches and algorithms
• Excellent programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, and test design
• Proven track record of operating highly-available systems at scale
• Ability to proactively learn new concepts and technology and apply them at work
• Skilled at solving ambiguous problems
• Strong collaboration and mentorship skills

Minimum Qualifications:
• BS in technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
• 14+ years of industry machine learning experience
• Experience with GPU/TPU training and optimizations

Preferred Qualifications:
• Masters/PhD in a technical field such as computer science
• Experience leading teams and driving technical roadmaps
• Experience working with machine learning, recommendation and ranking systems, or vector similarity search
• Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or related deep learning frameworks
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Ray, NoSQL solutions, Memcache/Redis, Google/AWS services
• Experienced in MLOps and managing production machine learning lifecycle

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a "default together" approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

Our Benefits : Snap Inc. is its own community, so we've got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap's long-term success!

• Lead the development of machine learning models to analyze and interpret vast amounts of data from space missions, enhancing our understanding of the cosmos and improving mission efficiency

• Collaborate with astronomers, engineers, and data scientists to integrate AI into our space exploration programs, ensuring the seamless operation of spacecraft and rovers

• Innovate in the field of remote sensing, applying machine learning to process and analyze satellite imagery for Earth observation, planetary science, and resource mapping
• Spearhead research initiatives to leverage AI in the development of life support systems, habitat automation, and sustainable space living solutions

• Promote a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, staying abreast of advancements in AI, machine learning, and space technology
• Engage in cross-sector collaborations to drive innovation in space technology, participating in conferences, workshops, and industry consortia
• Mentor and lead a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists, guiding project direction and fostering professional growth

• Passionate about space exploration and a strong desire to contribute to pioneering space missions
• 6+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with specific expertise in areas relevant to space technology, such as robotics, remote sensing, or autonomous systems
• Advanced understanding of ML algorithms, data processing, and statistical methods, with the ability to apply these in high-stakes, technically complex environments
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and C++, and familiarity with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Huggingface

• Direct experience in the space industry or working on space-related technology projects
• Published research or demonstrated innovation in the application of AI/ML to space exploration, robotics, or Earth observation

• Experience with simulating space missions or developing AI systems for space operations

• Unique opportunities to contribute to high-profile space missions and technologies
• Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options and a focus on work-life balance
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, with additional support for mental and physical wellness
• Continuous learning and development opportunities, including access to seminars, workshops, and training in space technology and AI
• A collaborative and innovative work environment, where creativity and groundbreaking ideas are actively encouraged and supported

Company Description

Adtalem Global Education is a national leader in post-secondary education and leading provider of professional talent to the healthcare industry. Adtalem educates and empowers students with the knowledge and skills to become leaders in their communities and make a lasting impact on public health, well-being and beyond. Through equitable access to education, environments that nurture student success, and a focus on expanding and diversifying the talent pipeline in healthcare, Adtalem is building a brighter future for communities and the world.

Adtalem is the parent organization of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University.

Visit Adtalem.com for more information, and follow on Twitter and LinkedIn.

Adtalem believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we can work flexibly. Depending on your location, this role may be hybrid or remote.
• HYBRID – If you reside within 50 miles of Adtalem offices in Chicago, IL, Addison, IL, Columbia, MD, Minneapolis, MN, and Miramar, FL this role is hybrid, requiring office presence three days a week (Tue, Wed, Thu), with the rest of the workweek spent working from home.

Job Description

The Director Data Science (Machine Learning) plays a key role in building and maintaining advanced analytic models, supporting Adtalem Global Education's institutions and Home Office in subjects related to admissions, retention, and financial outcomes; he/she will work closely with senior leadership to understand their needs and assess how they can be met through specific analyses.
• Identifies and manages existing and emerging risks that stem from business activities and the job role.
• Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled.
• Follows written risk and compliance policies, standards, and procedures for business activities.
• Collaborates with other analytical leaders to fulfill the strategic direction of the business through data and information exploration, research of emerging technologies or analytical techniques, and execution of assignments.
• Oversees and carries out the exploration of promising new technologies, analytical methods, and data sources (internal & external) that have potential to contribute to the enterprise.
• Partners with enterprise analytical and IT teams to build core capabilities and processes.
• Identifies additional resource needs ranging from IT investments, 3rd party support, or additional analysts.
• Understands the business direction, environment, and strategies to identify and recommend and plan a roadmap of solutions that influence decision makers and inspire change.
• Directs the design and construction of large and complex data sets from large amounts of structured and unstructured data (internal and external) to enable analytical solutions.
• Directs the ideation, development, deployment, monitoring, and automated refreshing of ML models that predict in real-time.
• Builds and leads a high performing team of experts in applications of AI/ML; develops team reputation as highly skilled experts in the field of data science and AI app development.

Qualifications
• Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Quantitative Economics, Statistics, or related field OR 6 additional years of related experience beyond the minimum required may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
• Eight (8) years of experience in predictive modeling, large data analysis and computer science.
• Three (3) years of direct management experience of data science function.
• Expert in at least one compiled language (e.g., Java, C) and one dynamic scripting language (e.g., Python).
• An Experience in stochastic modeling, machine learning, and other advanced mathematical techniques (e.g., neural nets, simulation, graph analysis).
• Strong record of communicating results, insights, and technical solutions to Senior Executive Management (or equivalent).
• Experience in data mining and wrangling and statistical analysis.
• Excellent pattern recognition and predictive modeling skills.
• Knowledge and application of data science principles and experience with data science methodologies.
• Experience with the following statistical and predictive modeling approaches: Gaussian Process; Markov Models; Hierarchical Clustering; K-Means; Linear Regression; Logistic Regression; Monte Carlo Simulation; Neural Networks.
• Deep technical skills, consulting experience, and business savvy to work with all levels and disciplines within our customers' organization.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate ideas with team members and/or business leaders to convey and present very technical information to an audience that may have little or no understanding of technical concepts in data science.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced knowledge of statistical methods, mathematics, and AI/ML algorithms including traditional general linear model (GLM) family models (including linear and logistic), tree-based methods (random forest, gradient boosted models), deep learning methods (neural networks, etc.), and general optimization methods (e.g., gradient descent, etc.).
• Knowledge in model performance evaluation techniques, metrics, and validations strategies (nested-cross-validation, etc.).
• Expert in data visualization principles, techniques, and tools.
• Expert in communicating concepts, proposals, ideas, and results to key decision makers.
• Expert in model testing, validation, and CI/CD techniques.
• Knowledge and familiarity with Google Cloud Platform.
• Not be afraid of hard work and doing things smarter, taking initiative, and providing leadership.
• Experience with Vertex AI ML Ops platform or similar.
• Experience with systems in the Education Space.
• Experience in experimental design.
• Experience in project and vendor management.
• Experience with Azure DevOps.

Additional Information

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $97,253.99 and $175,761.85. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements. The position qualifies for the below benefits.

Adtalem offers a robust suite of benefits including:
• Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
• 401k Retirement Program + 6% employer match
• Participation in Adtalem’s Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy
• 12 Paid Holidays

For more information related to our benefits please visit: https://careers.adtalem.com/benefits.

You are also eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

job_description:
Come shape the future of our industry by bringing Artificial Intelligence capabilities to life!

Digital Core IT is actively looking for an AI Monitoring Capability Platform Delivery Senior Director to lead a technical team building solutions that improve performance and reliability of processes and systems in pharma. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and the impact it can have across an entire industry? Are you a change agent who can influence organizations? If so, bring YOUR skills and talents to Lilly where you’ll have the chance to create an impact on the lives of patients!

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you will implement scale, re-use and speed in the design, engineering and deployment of AI Monitoring solutions. Leading both the strategy and execution of the monitoring capability that will enable sophisticated AI systems to drive innovation in operations across various domains and formats, using innovative AI technologies and tools.

How You’ll Succeed
• Effectively lead, develop, and mentor a technical team responsible for creating an enterprise AI Monitoring capability and platform, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting diversity and inclusion across all teams.
• Define and implement the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI Monitoring, ensuring alignment with the company’s goals and values.
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, designers, and other stakeholders to deliver engaging and relevant solutions for our customers and users.
• Establish and maintain best practices and standards for AI Monitoring, ensuring quality, consistency, and accuracy.
• Monitor and evaluate the performance and impact of AI Monitoring, in areas such as predictive maintenance, performance tracking, quality assurance and security/compliance, using data and metrics to identify areas of improvement and innovation.
• Research and explore new trends, technologies, and opportunities in the field of AI Monitoring, staying ahead of the curve and ensuring our competitive edge.

What You Should Bring
• A proven track record of leading teams, projects, and processes, delivering results on time and within budget.
• Advanced technical skills that are demonstrated in how you use technology daily to accelerate and advance impact.
• Applied experience and knowledge in the application of Generative AI or other AI to provide monitoring solutions that provide real time detection with suggestions or action and proactively prevent issues from happening.
• Prior experience using natural language processing (NLP), Foundation Models (FMs), and modern Large Language Models (LLMs), and other machine learning algorithms to create monitoring products and features.
• Superb communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex concepts and solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.
• A passion for storytelling, innovation, and excellence, with a keen eye for detail and quality.
• A high level of intellectual curiosity, external perspective, and innovation interest.

Your Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
• 10+ years of IT leadership experience with expertise in industry standard methodologies.
• 3+ years of experience in working with AI technologies and tools, such as natural language processing (NLP), AI generation, machine learning algorithms, deep learning, etc.

Additional Preferences:
• Position located in Indianapolis, Indiana working in a hybrid model. Remote work within the US may be considered.
• Travel may be required periodically.

Tech at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what’s possible through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

The Digital Core IT team leads Lilly’s transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world class capabilities and platforms.

This is a hybrid role working partially in-office (Lincoln, NE) and partially from home.

This position is responsible for collaborating with executive leadership to develop the company's AI strategy roadmap and enable the delivery of AI solutions that enable the company's strategy, mission, and goals. As the leader of AI, you will lead the AI capability for Ameritas and ensure we are advancing our use of this valuable technology in line with good standards of practice and applicability. This is your chance to shape strategy and propel AI capabilities to new horizons at Ameritas.

Utilize professional level verbal and written communication skills to deliver strategy and long-term vision to both technical and non-technical audiences. Provide clarity regarding the (AI) vision and expectations, and how the vision/strategy is aligned with and linked to the company vision/strategy. Utilize extensive expertise from a broad spectrum of data domains, encompassing data privacy, security measures, analytical methods, data management, and governance protocols.

Effectively partner with the security and legal functions to ensure compliance standards and processes are met to include protections for Intellectual Property. Build internal recognition as a trusted partner by business and functions, while maintaining strong relationships with senior leaders to champion collaboration across the enterprise. Utilize strong executive presence to deliver presentations and messages to broad audiences including executive leaders. Act as a champion of change leadership. Challenge the status quo in support of new technology directions.

At Ameritas, our mission is Fulfilling Life. We do that in many ways, but especially by helping people invest in themselves by offering trusted financial products and advice. Because we believe everyone should be happy, healthy, and financially secure, we work hard to provide trusted financial products and valued guidance, including individual life and disability insurance, employee benefits, retirement planning, investments, and wealth management services.

What you do
• Develop and lead a comprehensive AI strategy across the company, through effective collaboration with internal stakeholders (business & enterprise services), aligning with business objectives and product roadmaps to drive tangible business growth with a key focus on people, process, and technology.
• Develop & lead the AI capability at Ameritas including facilitation of a cross functional AI Council to determine and prioritize AI investments; participate in other emerging technology, innovation, and information governance councils.
• Define guiding principles of solution decisions for the enterprise; define corresponding KPIs; assess enterprise level drivers to determine corresponding technology, people, and process change requirements.
• Develop, champion, and execute standards, governance structure(s), and appropriate training programs to ensure AI systems are ethically and responsibly developed and utilized. This includes addressing issues such as bias in AI algorithms, fair representation of data, and transparency in AI decision-making.
• Oversee AI technologies and solutions implementation within the organization on relevant business use cases; collaborate with key stakeholders.
• Lead growth, culture, and continuous evolvement of innovative AI technical capabilities across the enterprise.
• Lead analysis of technology, industry, and emerging market trends to determine their potential impact and benefit within the enterprise.
• Collaborate closely with Executive & Leadership team(s) (including but not limited to CAIO, CIO, CISO, Legal, and Risk) to implement protection measures for Intellectual Property and data from unauthorized access, breaches, and misuse.
• Advise and collaborate with external and internal partners in driving strategic projects.
• Collaborate with information governance and data analytics team to ensure strategic alignment.

What you bring
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
• Master’s degree preferred.
• 7-10 years of progressive, relevant technology, engineering, and/or analytics experience required.
• Financial services and/or insurance industry experience desired.
• Expert level knowledge of architecture principles, practices, and standards (to ensure a well architected and secure environment) required.
• 5+ years’ experience at the Director/2VP level, leading highly complex business segments or corporate divisions desired.
• 5+ years’ experience in strategizing, shaping, and driving business value using Artificial Intelligence desired.
• 5+ years’ experience in traditional Machine Learning and deep learning techniques to solve complex business problems desired.
• 5+ years’ experience creating long-term roadmaps and providing strategic thought leadership for multi-year planning desired.
• Experience building team capabilities and business case discipline for aligning long term investment strategies and objectives desired.
• 5+ years’ experience influencing senior leaders on industry trends and emerging technologies (in anticipation of new business processes and systems) desired.
• Strong experience and knowledge of digital tools and services, cloud environments, automation, operational AI, and deployment tools/environments desired.

What We Offer
• Our company motto is “Fulfilling Life” and we take that job seriously, with a heavy commitment to volunteering and community support, employee well-being, and providing quality products and services that help our customers create a brighter future.
• Being a mutual-based organization, the return on our investment goes back into the company, to benefit our members/customers.
• We’re committed to professional development, opportunity, inclusion and diversity. Team building and collaboration are also priorities.
• A total rewards package with all the comprehensive health and welfare benefits you’d expect, including competitive pay and incentives, 401(k), flexible work schedules and time off to care for yourself and others.
• Additional popular benefits, including tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment, an incentivized well-being program, adoption assistance, paid time off for volunteering, training, and career development opportunities.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Ameritas has a reputation as a company that cares, and because everyone should feel safe bringing their authentic, whole self to work, we’re committed to an inclusive culture and diverse workplace, enriched by our individual differences. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer that hires based on qualifications, positive attitude, and exemplary work ethic, regardless of sex, race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

We build tools that help people feel in control of their financial future, including:
• Private student loans - low rates, people-first service, and flexible payments.
• Student loan refinancing - break free from high interest rates or monthly payments.
• Scholarships - access to thousands of scholarships to help students pay less.

The Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & AI, position will report to the Chief Operating Officer.

As the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & AI, you will:
• Play a pivotal role in driving business growth and overseeing key initiatives under the guidance of the Chief Operating Officer.
• Your responsibilities will extend to strategic planning, project leadership, and spearheading process improvements within the Operations Team.
• Working in close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Data & Analytics, and Finance, you will be instrumental in shaping the strategy across our Operations department and collaborating with key stakeholders across the company to evaluate and advance our AI (Artificial Intelligence) capabilities.

Your Impact:
• Collaborate on refining business strategies, identify growth opportunities through research, providing insights for strategic decision-making and evaluate and enhance existing processes.
• AI Technology Integration, implement cutting-edge AI solutions and collaborate for seamless AI technology integration.
• Utilize analytics for actionable insights, generate reports on key performance indicators, provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.
• Lead projects to achieve business objectives, develop plans, set milestones, allocate resources and ensure timely and successful project delivery.

About You:
• 7+ years in strategic roles: consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, development, business operations, or product.
• Proven track record in process improvement within operations, including enhancing efficiencies.
• Demonstrated expertise in evaluating and integrating AI to boost productivity within operations (Call Center, Workforce Management).
• Strategic mindset focused on streamlining business processes, with a focus on AI integration.
• Strong business acumen and analytical problem-solving skills, leveraging data for informed decision-making.
• Passionate commitment to enhancing customer experience and adding value.

Even Better:
• MBA degree
• Familiarity with the latest trends and advancements in technology beyond AI, contributing to a tech-forward approach.
• Comprehensive experience in contact center expertise.

About Us:

What makes an “Earnie” culture:
• Drivers – Drivers are satisfied by making things happen, not coming along for the ride. They feel a strong sense of ownership for their projects and teams and demand high standards from themselves and others.
• Humility – Humble team players check their egos and consider the team’s needs above their own. They are self-aware of their strengths and opportunities for improvement.
• Growth Mindset – People with a growth mindset approach challenges and failures as learning opportunities. They seek feedback to improve, give feedback to others, and genuinely want to perform well.

Earnies are committed to helping students live their best lives, free from the stress of student debt. If you’re as passionate as we are about our mission, read more below, and let’s build something great together!

Earnest believes in enabling our employees to live their best lives. We offer a variety of perks and competitive benefits, including:
• Health, Dental, & Vision benefits plus savings plans
• Work anywhere in the U.S.
• Mac computers + work from home stipend to set up your home office
• Monthly internet and phone reimbursement
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• RSUs
• 401(k) plan to help you save for retirement plus a company match
• Robust tuition reimbursement program
• $1,000 travel perk on each Earnie-versary to anywhere in the world
• Competitive days of annual PTO
• Annual “my day”
• Pet insurance!
• Competitive parental leave
• Plenty of Earnest swag, optional in person team gatherings, picnics, celebrations, and plenty of fun virtual events

At Earnest, we are committed to building an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. Our belief is that a strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, equity, and belonging enables us to move forward with our mission. We are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encourage anyone to apply if your experience is close to what we are looking for.

Earnest provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status disability or genetics. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for the position in a manner consistent with the Fair Chance Ordinance.

job_description:
Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we work closely with clients to embrace a transformational approach aimed at benefiting all stakeholders—empowering organizations to grow, build sustainable competitive advantage, and drive positive societal impact. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives that question the status quo and spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting, technology and design, and corporate and digital ventures. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, fueled by the goal of helping our clients thrive and enabling them to make the world a better place. BCG X BCG X is the tech build & design unit of BCG. Turbocharging BCG's deep industry and functional expertise, BCG X brings together advanced tech knowledge and ambitious entrepreneurship to help organizations enable innovation at scale. With nearly 3,000 technologists, scientists, programmers, engineers, and human-centered designers located across 80+ cities, BCG X builds and designs platforms and software to address the world's most important challenges and opportunities. Teaming across our practices, and in close collaboration with our clients, our end-to-end global team unlocks new possibilities. Together we're creating the bold and disruptive products, services, and businesses of tomorrow. Practice Area Profile What You'll Do The Responsible AI Risk Assessment and Measurement Lead/Senior Manager plays a critical role leading safety testing and red teaming efforts in conjunction with our AI and Generative AI product teams, to ensure alignment with our Responsible AI policy, principles, and standards, and to support the design, continuous improvement, and execution of the overall Responsible AI program at BCG. YOU’RE GOOD AT Working in a fast-paced environment where you engage with a myriad of AI/GenAI product teams working across client, industry, and geographic contexts to identify and mitigate safety risks associated with AI/GenAI systems, using your experience with and passion for AI/GenAI risk assessment and measurement to look for ways we can continually improve our AI/GenAI products, while coordinating with stakeholders across BCG and contributing to thought leadership. The Responsible AI Risk Assessment and Measurement Lead/Manager works with a diverse set of stakeholders to: Execute RAI Risk Assessment and Measurement operations on AI/GenAI systems in development and production using real-world adversarial techniques to identify failures

Develop tools and techniques to scale and accelerate Risk Assessment and Measurement across BCG Collaborate with case teams to influence measurement and mitigations of vulnerabilities in AI/GenAI systems through manual efforts and scalable, quantitative approaches Research new and emerging threats to inform AI/GenAI Risk Assessment and Measurement efficacy and accuracy, and to stay relevant Mentor staff in techniques, approaches, and best practices AI/GenAI Risk Assessment and Measurement Manage small teams of technical and non-technical staff executing Risk Assessment and Measurement operations on AI/GenAI systems Develop and deliver trainings in AI/GenAI Risk Assessment and Measurement

Create playbooks to capture processes, approaches, and best practices for AI/GenAI Risk Assessment and Measurement

Remain up to date on emerging frameworks, standards, technical approaches, and related issues by participating in workshops, reading professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in professional organizations Identify and develop partnership opportunities with key players in the Responsible AI/GenAI Risk Assessment and Measurement domain What You'll Bring (Experience & Qualifications) 5-12+ years of experience in a technical environment, including data science, engineering, or technical program/product management

3+ years of experience in machine learning and/or AI/GenAI environments, preferably testing and red-teaming discovery and prevention or related fields Understanding of detecting threats related to unsafe content in AI/GenAI models or systems Demonstrable knowledge of Responsible AI policy, governance, trends, frameworks, and best practices, particularly with respect to GenAI systems Demonstrable experience building and implementing tools, playbooks, and policies with cross-functional teams Expert experience coordinating activities and managing stakeholders in large, complex environments Excellent written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences Stellar problem-solving and risk identification/mitigation skills in business contexts YOU'LL WORK WITH You will work in a fast-paced, intellectually challenging, product-oriented environment where we advance our thinking about and operationalization of Responsible AI Risk Assessment and Measurement. You will engage with a diverse set of stakeholders, including senior BCG leadership, case teams developing products for clients, internal product developers, product managers, legal, compliance, and security teams, BCG X’s Chief AI Ethics Officer, the Director of the Responsible AI team, and other members of the Responsible AI team. Boston Consulting Group ("BCG") is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. First-year minimum base compensation for the Lead role is $155,000. First-year minimum base compensation for the Senior Manager role is $169,000. In addition to your base salary, you will also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus and BCG’s Profit Sharing and Retirement Fund (PSRF) contribution. BCG also provides a market leading benefits package described below. At BCG, we are committed to offering a comprehensive benefit program that includes everything our employees and their families need to be well and live life to the fullest. We pay the full cost of medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees – and their eligible family members.* That’s zero dollars in premiums taken from employee paychecks. All our plans provide best in class coverage: Zero dollar ($0) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 (USD) in orthodontia benefits Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities Fully vested retirement contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not Generous paid time off including vacation, holidays, and annual office closure between Christmas and New Years Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement *Employees, spouses, and children are covered at no cost. Employees share in the cost of domestic partner coverage. #BCGXjob

Job Description

Summary:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Generative AI Full Stack Architect to join our team in USA. You will be responsible for the design, development, and deployment of generative AI models and systems that will power our next-generation products and services. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers and scientists to push the boundaries of what is possible with generative AI.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy generative AI models and systems across the full stack, from data pipelines to front-end applications.
• Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers to define and execute the technical roadmap for generative AI projects.
• Lead the architecture and design of generative AI systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.
• Develop and implement best practices for generative AI model development, deployment, and monitoring.
• Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in generative AI research and apply them to our products and services.
• Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on generative AI initiatives.
• Design generative AI models and outputs seamlessly into user interfaces.
• Stay up-to-date on the latest front-end frameworks and libraries (e.g., React, Vue.js, Angular) and apply them to generative AI projects.
• Optimize front-end performance and responsiveness for various platforms and devices.
• Collaborate with designers and UI/UX experts to ensure a consistent and intuitive user experience.
• Design robust and scalable back-end APIs for generative AI models.
• Implement efficient data pipelines to feed data to and extract outputs from generative AI models.
• Choose and optimize backend technologies (e.g., Python, Java, Node.js) based on model requirements and system limitations.
• Ensure the security and reliability of generative AI systems in production.
• Utilize M365 Power platforms Co-pilot to enhance Gen AI Capabilities in the o365 applications.
• Frame proper architecture , governance and data loss prevention policies for Co-Pilot to be implemented in the organisation
• Leverage AI Builder to incorporate artificial intelligence capabilities into Power Apps, Power Virtual Agents and Power Automate workflows
• Guide the application engineers to design, develop , and implement applications and integrations utilizing Microsoft Graph APIs.

Qualifications:
• Master's degree or bachelor's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on full-stack development.
• 4+ years of experience with generative AI models and techniques, such as GANs, VAEs, and autoregressive models.
• Strong understanding of deep learning frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or MXNet.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Strong passion for generative AI and its potential to transform the world.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job_description:
Inizio Partners is a top-rated executive hiring and IT placement firm serving clients globally. Inizio's clients include Fortune 500 companies, consulting firms, defense contractors, startups, private equity & venture capital firms, etc.

We are currently recruiting for a Competency Leader - Generative AI (VP Role) for one of our key customers, a Nasdaq-listed data analytics and digital operations & solutions company that partners with clients to improve business outcomes and unlock growth. By bringing together deep domain expertise with robust data, powerful analytics, cloud, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML), we create agile, scalable solutions and execute complex operations for the worlds leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media, and retail, among others.

The Generative AI Competency Leader will be responsible for driving the growth and success of our practice focused on generative artificial intelligence (AI). This role requires a combination of technical expertise, industry knowledge, and leadership abilities to deliver innovative generative AI solutions to our clients. The Practice Leader will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop and execute strategies that leverage generative AI techniques across various domains.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Practice Development: Develop and implement a comprehensive growth strategy for the generative AI practice, aligned with the company's overall business objectives. Identify new business opportunities and cultivate relationships with key stakeholders interested in generative AI solutions.

2. Develop AI Strategy & offerings: Collaborate with clients to define their AI vision and goals. Design customized AI strategies & offerings aligned with their business objectives, industry trends, and technological advancements.

3. Lead Implementation of AI Solutions: Lead the implementation of AI solutions by working closely with cross-functional teams. Define project scopes, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure seamless integration of AI technologies into existing systems and processes.

4. Provide Expert Guidance: Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives and stakeholders, offering expert guidance on AI-related decisions. Educate and raise awareness about AI best practices, potential risks, and ethical considerations.

5. Lead AI Transformation: Drive AI transformation initiatives, including change management, training programs, and cultural shifts. Foster a data-driven mindset within organizations and promote the adoption of AI across various departments.

6. Stay Current with AI Developments: Continuously research and evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies. Keep abreast of industry trends and advancements to provide up-to-date recommendations.

7. Collaborate with AI Specialists: Work closely with AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and other relevant stakeholders to develop cutting-edge AI solutions. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and innovation.

8. Measure and Evaluate: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the effectiveness of AI initiatives. Regularly monitor progress, evaluate outcomes, and provide insightful reports to clients.

9. Client Engagement:
• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, understanding their business needs, and providing tailored generative AI solutions.
• Lead client engagements, including scoping projects, defining deliverables, and managing successful project execution.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality delivery of generative AI projects within agreed timelines and budgets.

10. Team Leadership:
• Build and manage a high-performing team of data scientists, AI researchers, and engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and innovation.
• Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, supporting their professional development and career growth.
• Conduct performance evaluations, set goals, and ensure the team's productivity and effectiveness.

11. Thought Leadership:
• Establish the company and the generative AI practice as a thought leader through research publications, conference presentations, and contributions to the generative AI community.
• Contribute to the development of intellectual property, methodologies, and best practices specific to generative AI.

Key elements for the role:
• 15+ years of experience in generative AI, including hands-on experience with state-of-the-art generative models and techniques.
• Proven track record of successfully leading and delivering generative AI projects in industry settings.
• Strong knowledge of AI and machine learning algorithms, frameworks, and tools, with a specific focus on generative AI techniques.
• Understanding of data engineering and preprocessing techniques for generative AI models.
• Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence clients and stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and strategic thinking abilities.

Education:
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, data science, artificial intelligence). Advanced degree preferred.
• Preferably MBA

Corporate Social Responsibility

A socially and environmentally conscious corporate organization, our customer understands its larger responsibilities towards employees, clients, investors, and society. We believe in actively and consistently investing in the future of the communities in which we operate. It is this belief of achieving the next level of excellence in driving social change that our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program delivers on.

What we offer
• We offer an exciting, dynamic, fast-paced, and innovative environment, which brings together a group of sharp and entrepreneurial professionals who are eager to influence business decisions. From your very first day, you have the opportunity to work closely with highly experienced, world-class Analytics professionals. You can expect to learn many aspects of businesses that our clients engage in.
• We provide guidance/ coaching to every employee through our mentoring program wherein every junior-level employee is assigned a senior-level professional as an advisor.
• The sky is the limit for our team members. The unique experiences gathered here sets the stage for further growth and development in our company and beyond.
